card.name: Permanently discontinue instructions
card.fires_on: The ending "ently" of "Permanently" at the start of an instruction to stop a drug, usually in dosage-modification or warnings text.

modes.label: Permanently discontinue
modes.description: Sentence-opening "Perman|ently" followed by discontinue and a drug name, after a severe reaction is described.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about stopping, ending, or ruling out, such as "incompatible", "disqualified" and Chinese words for stop or ruin.
card.plain: It fires on the word "Permanently" when a label tells the reader to stop a drug for good.
